name: print-social-slate-two-font-line-height-typography-rule-post
title: Two Fonts and Line Height Rule Post
whatItIs: A slate-blue slide, Rule 2 Typography, saying to use two fonts maximum, one for headings and one for body, and to keep line height between 140% and 160%, with two small text samples comparing auto and 160% line height.
whatItMeans: Showing the same paragraph at two line heights lets viewers see the difference, and a two-colour layout keeps it clear.
techniques: Condensed caps sub-labels above light statements
Large numeric range as a key figure
Small sample paragraphs in two columns

vocabulary.definition: The vertical distance between lines of text.
A rule of using only two typefaces in a design.
Two versions of the same content shown together.
